checklist.evidence: All 66 changed files listed in coverage: 59 reviewed as source code and configuration, 7 placeholders and historical manifests listed as not_reviewed with reasons.

Phase P-1 bootstrap closes every protected file (scripts/fleet/**, scripts/jev/**, scripts/release/**, etc.), policy (policy.json with SHA-256 hash), contracts (P-1.json through P10.json generated by gen-contracts.mjs), and CI jobs (protected-paths.yml, receipt-verify.yml, jev-pr.yml, jev-ratchet.yml, openapi-drift.yml). Amendments AM-1 (Cloudroom substrate), AM-2 (fleet merges via merge-phase.mjs), AM-3 (P10 billing phase), AM-4 (policy in-repo), and AM-5 (orchestrator protected-change trailer) are all implemented.

No check weakened. guard.mjs places the gh pr merge exemption before the forbidden_commands loop (fixing the unreachable exemption from r1). lib.mjs isMain() uses fileURLToPath() to handle paths with spaces (fixing the silent exit from r3). check-bootstrap.mjs accepts both linux and darwin platforms (fixing the Mac Mini rejection from r3).
No mutants were planted or executed during this review; the diff was analyzed statically.
checklist.reason: Static review only; no mutation testing performed.

checklist.evidence: guard.mjs evaluate() denies 12 planted forbidden actions (protected path writes by builder, secret file writes, force push, no-verify, direct gh pr merge, denied MCP tools) and allows 3 benign actions (unprotected write, npm test, MCP read). The releaser role with via:merge-phase is correctly allowed for gh pr merge commands.

check-bootstrap.mjs validates Node version >= 22, git repo presence, policy hash match, halt file absence, committer identity, review lane availability, Done harness, local DATABASE_URL, repo controls, protected script presence, and scheduler existence. selftest.mjs validates guard behavior, policy hash, Node floor, absence of .worktreeinclude and .env files, and sandbox isolation.

Protected paths are confined to scripts/fleet/**, scripts/jev/**, scripts/release/**, scripts/gate/**, scripts/truth/**, .github/**, release-receipts/**, and specific configuration files. verify-protected.mjs enforces these with exemptions only for own-phase receipts (validated), ledger rows, bootstrap (when policy absent at base), and orchestrator protected-change commits (with Fleet-Role and Protected-Change trailers per AM-5).

Outbound actions (git push, gh pr merge, gh api calls) are gated by role checks in guard.mjs and merge-phase.mjs. merge-phase.mjs requires halt clearance, exact-head checks, valid receipt, independent review, and attest-phase success before merging. fanout.mjs spawns child threads in Cloudroom sandboxes (AM-1). No new external HTTP endpoints or third-party SDKs added.
